title: How to do speech-to-speech using the OpenAI Realtime API

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the OpenAI Realtime API.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹 OpenAI Realtime API。

cues.en: So, the Realtime API is the way we can do speech-to-speech, meaning we can ask the question in audio and actually also get audio responses back.
cues.zh: Realtime API 能進行語音對語音，也就是用聲音提問，再直接取得語音回覆。

cues.en: So, let's go into a demo.
cues.zh: 先看示範。

cues.en: So, here I have the code running, and I have the output over here.
cues.zh: 這裡程式正在執行，輸出在旁邊。

cues.en: So, let's first see a demo, and then we'll go to the code.
cues.zh: 先實際操作，再看程式碼。

cues.en: Hi there.
cues.zh: 你好。

cues.en: Hello. How's it going? What can I help you with today?
cues.zh: 你好，最近如何？今天有什麼可以幫你的？

cues.en: Fine. Can you tell me what the capital of France is?
cues.zh: 很好。可以告訴我法國首都是哪裡嗎？

cues.en: Of course. The capital of France is Paris.
cues.zh: 當然，法國的首都是巴黎。

cues.en: It's known for its art, culture, and landmarks like the Eiffel Tower.
cues.zh: 巴黎以藝術、文化，以及艾菲爾鐵塔等地標聞名。

cues.en: Cool. Can you tell me how many people live in that city?
cues.zh: 不錯。那這座城市有多少人口？

cues.en: Sure. Paris has a population of around 2 million people in the city itself, and if you include the greater metropolitan area, it's about 12 million.
cues.zh: 巴黎市區大約有兩百萬人；如果包含整個大都會區，則大約有一千兩百萬人。

cues.en: Okay. Thank you.
cues.zh: 好，謝謝。

cues.en: You're welcome. If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.
cues.zh: 不客氣，如果還有問題，隨時都可以問。

cues.en: So, that's the demo.
cues.zh: 以上就是示範。

cues.en: We talked about Paris, but we can talk about anything.
cues.zh: 剛才聊的是巴黎，當然也可以聊其他任何主題。

cues.en: So, let's have a look at what the code actually does and why it works the way it works.
cues.zh: 接著看看程式碼實際做了什麼，以及為什麼這樣運作。

cues.en: So, we first get our normal sequence, and then we make either our OpenAI client or our Azure OpenAI client, but we're not actually making an Azure OpenAI client,
cues.zh: 首先取得一般的秘密設定，再建立 OpenAI 用戶端；如果使用 Azure，也不是直接建立 AzureOpenAIClient，

cues.en: because if we do that, it will actually come back with an exception saying the Realtime API is not supported, and we should use the OpenAI client instead.
cues.zh: 因為那樣會拋出例外，表示不支援 Realtime API，要求改用 OpenAIClient。

cues.en: I think this is a first step in switching to everything being in the OpenAI client and then for Azure setting an endpoint,
cues.zh: 我認為這可能是逐漸把所有功能整合到 OpenAIClient，再由 Azure 指定端點的第一步，

cues.en: because this is also the first time we really used the new slash OpenAI slash v1 endpoint with OpenAI.
cues.zh: 因為這也是我們第一次真正使用新的 /openai/v1 端點。

cues.en: So, the way we do it here is then we say Azure OpenAI client and then set the endpoint, as we have seen a few times before as well.
cues.zh: 因此這裡使用 OpenAIClient，再指定 Azure OpenAI 的端點，和先前某些範例類似。

cues.en: And once we have the client, we can get the Realtime client, because the API is not the chat client or the responses API, it's what is called Realtime client instead.
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，再取得 RealtimeClient；這不是 Chat Client 或 Responses API，而是獨立的 Realtime 用戶端。

cues.en: We also need models, and this is a model we haven't used before, so if you're on Azure, you might need to deploy this model.
cues.zh: 也需要指定模型；這是之前沒用過的模型，如果使用 Azure，可能要先部署。

cues.en: There's either a GPT Realtime, there's a... for mini, a non-mini, and there's a 1.5 version as well.
cues.zh: 有 GPT Realtime、Mini、一般版本，以及 1.5 版本。

cues.en: These are a bit expensive, like $10 per 1 million tokens and $20 million for output,
cues.zh: 價格稍高，例如每百萬輸入 Token 十美元，輸出二十美元，

cues.en: and if you go to the non-mini, it's $32 and $64.
cues.zh: 非 Mini 版本則是三十二與六十四美元。

cues.en: In real life, testing it out, I've sat here for a couple of hours and preparing this demo, and that has cost me roughly half a US dollar.
cues.zh: 實際上，我花幾個小時準備並測試這個範例，大約用了半美元。

cues.en: So, not too, too expensive, but still.
cues.zh: 所以也不算特別昂貴，但還是要注意。

cues.en: You can also give one more model for transcriptions, meaning when we talk, that they can actually see what we said in text,
cues.zh: 另外可以指定轉錄模型，讓系統把我們說的話轉成文字，

cues.en: as we saw in our output.
cues.zh: 就像剛才的輸出。

cues.en: This is optional, so if you want to save that, if you don't need it anyway, you can get rid of it.
cues.zh: 這是選填；如果不需要文字轉錄，想節省費用，就可以移除。

cues.en: I will show a little later how we can do that.
cues.zh: 稍後會示範如何做。

cues.en: Then, when we ran it, it said we could press Ctrl-C to cancel.
cues.zh: 執行時，畫面說可以按 Ctrl+C 取消。

cues.en: That is just a console.cancel key press here.
cues.zh: 這只是使用 Console.CancelKeyPress。

cues.en: And then we take our Realtime Client, and then we start a conversation, and that conversation happens with the model.
cues.zh: 接著用 RealtimeClient 啟動對話，並指定模型。

cues.en: And then we configure the session, and there's a bunch of settings we can set on this.
cues.zh: 然後設定 session，這裡有很多選項。

cues.en: I've taken the most common ones here that I thought we needed.
cues.zh: 我先列出自己認為比較常用的。

cues.en: So, we can give instructions, just like system message, it should talk in a special way, and so on.
cues.zh: 可以提供指示，就像系統訊息，要求特定說話方式。

cues.en: And I'm just giving it that it's a voice assistant, and it needs to be clear and brief.
cues.zh: 這裡只說它是語音助理，回答要清楚簡短。

cues.en: Then, we can set some audio options, meaning input audio.
cues.zh: 接著能設定音訊選項，先看輸入音訊。

cues.en: So, for the input, if we want a transcription, we set this.
cues.zh: 如果需要輸入語音的轉錄，就設定這一項。

cues.en: If we don't, we can just take it away.
cues.zh: 不需要的話，直接拿掉即可。

cues.en: You can control some noise reduction, if need be.
cues.zh: 必要時也可以設定降噪。

cues.en: And then there's turn detection, which is the main part we do here.
cues.zh: 然後是這裡的重點：輪次偵測。

cues.en: So, it goes in, and you can set various options here, like whenever I start speaking,
cues.zh: 可以設定各種選項，例如開始說話時，

cues.en: how many milliseconds do it need to go back in the recording in order to pick up the first words I say,
cues.zh: 要往前保留多少毫秒的錄音，確保不漏掉最初說出的字，

cues.en: how long should it wait for a pause until it actually begins answering, and how long time should it wait
cues.zh: 停頓多久之後開始回答，以及要等多久，

cues.en: before it tries to do a follow-up for us, meaning if we are just silent, it says, hey, I can't hear you, is there something we should talk about?
cues.zh: 才主動追問；例如我們一直沉默，它就問：「我沒聽到聲音，有什麼想聊的嗎？」

cues.en: And finally, we have if we want to be able to interrupt, meaning in the middle of the AI speaking, if we want to say something else,
cues.zh: 最後可以設定是否允許打斷，也就是 AI 說話到一半時，使用者又開口，

cues.en: if that should happen or not, or it should finish its sentence.
cues.zh: 要不要中斷它，還是讓它把話說完。

cues.en: It doesn't happen instantly, but at a certain point in the longer conversation it gives back,
cues.zh: 這不是完全即時發生，而是在較長回覆的某個位置，

cues.en: it can stop itself and begin to ask in a follow-up question.
cues.zh: 它可以停止原本的內容，改為處理後續問題。

cues.en: Then we have output, where we can control how fast they speak and which of the different voices we want to have, male or female.
cues.zh: 輸出方面，可以控制說話速度，以及選用不同的男性或女性聲線。

cues.en: I've used this Marin, it sounds nice.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Marin，聽起來不錯。

cues.en: And for output, we just tell it everything is audio.
cues.zh: 輸出模式則指定為音訊。

cues.en: Technically, the real-time can also work with images and text, but that's beyond this video.
cues.zh: 技術上 Realtime 也能處理圖片與文字，但超出這支影片範圍。

cues.en: Then we do all the in-audio stuff.
cues.zh: 接著處理 NAudio 的部分。

cues.en: In-audio is a NuGet package to work with audio on Windows.
cues.zh: NAudio 是 Windows 上處理音訊的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And up here, we will put in an audio player.
cues.zh: 先在這裡建立音訊播放器。

cues.en: So essentially, I don't want to go into this, but it's essentially just that we can talk with the...
cues.zh: 細節不深入介紹，基本上就是能夠，

cues.en: or we can play back streaming audio feedback that we get from the API.
cues.zh: 播放 API 回傳的串流音訊。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we have a microphone streamer that we can start a recording, and then we can restart that recording for every time we have something new,
cues.zh: 同樣也有 MicrophoneStreamer，可以開始錄音，每次有新內容時進行相關的重設，

cues.en: but else the microphone is open all the time, waiting for us to set.
cues.zh: 平常則讓麥克風持續開啟，等待我們說話。

cues.en: Again, this is...
cues.zh: 再次說明，這部分，

cues.en: This is vibe-coded from using Codecs, and it's just C-sharp more than anything.
cues.zh: 是我透過 Codex 協助撰寫，主要是 C# 音訊處理，不是 AI 的特殊邏輯。

cues.en: And then we do something a bit special, because this is an open-ended system.
cues.zh: 接著有點不同，因為這是持續開放的系統。

cues.en: So instead of doing a wait and async, we just have these things for tasks.
cues.zh: 不是一般單次 await 呼叫，而是使用幾個持續執行的 Task。

cues.en: So we are keeping a continuous task of uploading Microsoft Audio, and we have a continuous task of receiving updates back.
cues.zh: 一個持續上傳麥克風音訊，另一個持續接收更新。

cues.en: Upload is fairly simple.
cues.zh: 上傳相當簡單。

cues.en: It's just taking the microphone and read everything that has been said so far into chunks, and put it into the session.
cues.zh: 只是從麥克風讀取錄音，切成區塊，再送進 session。

cues.en: So session being from the real-time that we created.
cues.zh: 也就是剛才建立的 Realtime session。

cues.en: And then we receive the updates, but before we look at that, let's just see that we just start our microphone, and then we begin to await receiving updates.
cues.zh: 接著接收更新；在看細節之前，先啟動麥克風，再開始等待接收更新。

cues.en: And at some point, we will press Ctrl-C or stop the program, and we will get a cancellation, where we just cancel everything.
cues.zh: 之後按 Ctrl+C 或停止程式，就會收到取消訊號，並取消所有工作。

cues.en: We stop the microphone, we clear the audio player, and then we're done.
cues.zh: 停止麥克風、清除播放器，流程就結束。

cues.en: But the most important thing happens down in receive updates.
cues.zh: 不過最重要的部分在 ReceiveUpdates。

cues.en: So every time, we just have a receive update, and it can do an await for each update.
cues.zh: 它會持續接收更新，透過 await foreach 逐筆處理。

cues.en: And every one of these updates is something different.
cues.zh: 每筆更新可能是不同的事件。

cues.en: The first one we normally get is a session created, where we can just then write some text out.
cues.zh: 通常第一個是 SessionCreated，我們可以輸出文字說明。

cues.en: We say the session is created, speak naturally, and wait for the AI to answer back, and press Ctrl-C.
cues.zh: 例如：session 已建立，請自然說話並等待 AI 回答，按 Ctrl+C 結束。

cues.en: Then there's a buffer speech started, meaning whenever we begin to speak, it tells, oh, I'm in listening mode right now.
cues.zh: 接著有 SpeechStarted，表示我們開始說話，系統進入聆聽狀態。

cues.en: So we just say, listening back in our console here.
cues.zh: 所以主控台會輸出 Listening。

cues.en: And whenever we stop speaking, we get the speech stopped, and then it begins to think, because it might take a little while
cues.zh: 停止說話時，會收到 SpeechStopped，再進入思考狀態，因為，

cues.en: for our question to be answered based on how difficult the answer is.
cues.zh: 回答可能依問題難度需要一點時間。

cues.en: Then, if we have to transcribe in place, we get a transcribe completed object, where we can just say what we said.
cues.zh: 如果啟用轉錄，就會取得 TranscriptionCompleted 事件，讓我們顯示剛才說了什麼。

cues.en: And we can also get the transcribe from the other side
cues.zh: 另一邊也能取得文字轉錄，

cues.en: on what the AI said.
cues.zh: 也就是 AI 回覆的內容。

cues.en: We can get it back here in just a done, but there's also a delta version where we can get it back streaming if need be.
cues.zh: 這裡等到完成後一次取得；也有 Delta 版本，必要時可以逐段接收。

cues.en: I tend to not to do that.
cues.zh: 我自己通常不這樣顯示。

cues.en: But what we do need is we need to get a delta of all the audio that's being said.
cues.zh: 但音訊一定要逐段接收 Delta。

cues.en: So every time a small piece of what is being said is put in, we enqueue that into the audio player,
cues.zh: 每次收到一小段要播放的聲音，就加入音訊播放器的佇列，

cues.en: so it will know when it can begin to give data back.
cues.zh: 讓播放器依序開始播放。

cues.en: If we ever clear the buffer, we can just clear the audio player.
cues.zh: 如果要清除緩衝區，就把音訊播放器清空。

cues.en: And when our response is done, we flush the pending audio, so we just have it tell out the rest of the data.
cues.zh: 回覆完成後，Flush 剩餘音訊，確保最後的內容都播放出來。

cues.en: And if there's any errors or anything, we can get, for example, error messages back if there's something wrong with the response.
cues.zh: 如果發生問題，也能取得回覆中的錯誤訊息。

cues.en: And finally, if there's any errors.
cues.zh: 最後還有一般的錯誤處理。

cues.en: So we can try to set some breakpoints here and see it in real life.
cues.zh: 我們設幾個中斷點，實際看看。

cues.en: This will feel a bit odd because it just begins to...
cues.zh: 過程可能有點奇怪，因為它會開始，

cues.en: to say words and pause it again and so on, but let's have a look.
cues.zh: 說幾個字又停住，不過還是看一下。

cues.en: So whenever we, say, start session up here,
cues.zh: 在上方開始 session，

cues.en: start conversation, we get that the session created.
cues.zh: 啟動對話後，就會收到 SessionCreated。

cues.en: There's also a session updated, which technically happens, but I haven't had any need for it, but there's a real-time server update session configuration updated.
cues.zh: 其實還有 SessionUpdated；我目前沒有用到，但它會在 session 設定更新時發出。

cues.en: But we get this, and we are ready to speak.
cues.zh: 收到這個事件後，就能開始說話。

cues.en: And now I spoke something, so it thought that we are listening to that.
cues.zh: 現在我說了一些話，所以它判斷目前正在聆聽。

cues.en: And now it hears that we don't speak anymore, so it's beginning to think about it.
cues.zh: 接著偵測到我們不說話了，於是開始思考。

cues.en: It will become a very odd conversation here.
cues.zh: 這段對話會變得很奇怪。

cues.en: And now I'd have to transcribe back,
cues.zh: 現在取得轉錄結果，

cues.en: which, yeah, okay.
cues.zh: 嗯，好。

cues.en: It couldn't understand what I was saying while we did this, but now we are getting the audio back in small chunks, so this one will be hit multiple times.
cues.zh: 剛才一邊除錯一邊說話，所以它沒有聽懂；現在開始逐小段回傳音訊，這個中斷點會觸發很多次。

cues.en: I'm pressing F5 right now, multiple times.
cues.zh: 我現在一直在按 F5。

cues.en: I'll just get rid of it here.
cues.zh: 直接把中斷點移除。

cues.en: And now the transcribe is done on what it is it wants to say back.
cues.zh: 現在，模型準備回覆的文字轉錄已經完成。

cues.en: So, sure, I'm here to help.
cues.zh: 內容是：「當然，我在這裡幫忙。」

cues.en: That normally comes just before the audio comes back.
cues.zh: 通常文字會在音訊開始播放前一點點到達。

cues.en: So it writes that back, and it now says, So it writes that back, and it now says, we are done, so now it begins to speak.
cues.zh: 它先輸出文字，再表示回覆完成，接著播放剩下的音訊。

cues.en: So if I press F5 here.
cues.zh: 現在按 F5。

cues.en: Could you tell me a bit more about what you'd like to talk about or what kind of support you're looking for?
cues.zh: 可以再多說一點，你想聊什麼，或需要哪方面的協助嗎？

cues.en: Of course. I'm here to help.
cues.zh: 當然，我很樂意幫忙。

cues.en: Take your time and share what's on your mind, and we can go from there. Thank you.
cues.zh: 慢慢來，告訴我你的想法，我們再繼續。謝謝。

cues.en: You're very welcome. Just let me know whenever you're ready, and we can dive into it together.
cues.zh: 非常不客氣。準備好時隨時告訴我，我們一起看看。

cues.en: So as you can see, it's quite difficult to debug, of course, hence putting out various messages along the way.
cues.zh: 如你所見，這種程式比較難除錯，所以才沿途輸出各種訊息。

cues.en: But that's just the nature of trying to speak while also trying to speak in this video, of course.
cues.zh: 而且我同時又要錄影片講解，語音互動本來就容易混在一起。

cues.en: So that is actually what's there.
cues.zh: 基本上就是這些內容。

cues.en: Again, the hard part, for me at least, was to get someone to make this start and stop recording of audio streams and playing back the audio streams.
cues.zh: 至少對我來說，最難的是處理音訊串流錄音的開始、停止，以及串流播放。

cues.en: Beyond that, it is fairly simple.
cues.zh: 除此之外，流程相當簡單。

cues.en: There's tons of settings, and this can do much, much more than what we are covering in this video.
cues.zh: 它有很多設定，能力也遠超過這支影片示範的範圍。

cues.en: But beyond that, it's fairly simple to understand once you go through it line by line.
cues.zh: 不過逐行看過後，基本架構就很容易理解。

cues.en: This is a bit funky, of course, that we are not really making normal code with the same weight, but it makes sense
cues.zh: 當然，這種寫法和一般同步等待回覆的程式不太一樣，但因為，

cues.en: when we are just having an open microphone waiting for data.
cues.zh: 麥克風一直開著等待資料，所以這樣設計很合理。

cues.en: So I think that's everything. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容，我們下支影片見。
